name: Osmium Social Links
description: One place for the business's social profile URLs, shown as a list of links by a theme and available to other services such as Schema

setup.postInstallNote: Adds nothing to the page until a link is saved on Content > Social Links. The 'social-links' hook is rendered in place by a theme (for example in its footer) with $template['serviceBlock']('social-links'); the markup is a plain list of text links with a data-network attribute on each item. A theme that wants icons renders its own list from OsmiumSocialLinksConfig::filled(OsmiumSocialLinksConfig::get()) and chooses the icons itself. Other services read the saved URLs from this service's config context as $osmiumSocialLinks['links'] without depending on it.
